email_click_rate.label: Email click rate
email_click_rate.definition: Delivered messages with at least one qualifying human click / delivered messages. Repeat clicks collapse to message ID; known bot clicks excluded.

engagement_rate.label: Engaged sessions
engagement_rate.definition: Eligible landing sessions lasting more than 10 seconds, with at least two pageviews, or with a registration / eligible landing sessions.

registration_rate.label: Registration rate
registration_rate.definition: Eligible landing sessions with a registration / eligible landing sessions.

attendance_rate.label: Webinar attendance
attendance_rate.definition: Distinct registered webinar/person pairs with positive attendee time / distinct webinar/person registrations. Rejoins collapse; presenters excluded. Periods use event date.

issues.title: Campaign tags split the hepatitis journey
issues.evidence: Hepatitis_2026 appears in web exports but has no approved mapping.
issues.action: Review and add the explicit mapping, then rebuild. Preserve the original raw tag.
issues.resolution: Reclassification can recover attributable records; it cannot create new audience activity.

issues.title: A webinar file was exported twice
issues.evidence: webinar.csv and webinar-reexport.csv have identical SHA-256 hashes. Attendee rejoins also exist.
issues.action: Skip the identical file. Count webinar/person pairs, not attendance rows.
issues.resolution: Exact file deduplication is automatic; conflicting event IDs are quarantined.

issues.title: The hepatitis registration link is hidden on mobile
issues.evidence: Seeded WordPress landing pages hide their registration action at narrow widths.
issues.action: Edit the asset metadata in WordPress, publish and run a fresh mobile test journey.
issues.resolution: A passing test verifies the current path. Historical conversion rates stay unchanged.
